title: Trace a word through a letter grid
summary: A word game board is a grid of letters. Determine whether the requested word can be formed by moving to horizontally or vertically adjacent cells, using each cell at most once in a single trace. Do not allow diagonal moves.
requirements: Moves can be up, down, left, or right, not diagonal.
A cell cannot be reused in one word trace.
An empty word is always found.
hints: Try each cell as a possible starting point.
Use DFS with backtracking, marking cells visited only for the current path.
